findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two aware datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo, which uses wall-clock difference instead of real elapsed time, so sessions spanning a DST transition (spring forward, fall back, ambiguous fold times) are over- or under-billed; convert both to UTC before subtracting.

judge.reason: Same cause: same-ZoneInfo aware datetime subtraction uses wall clock, misbilling DST-crossing sessions; fix is UTC conversion.

findings.label: hit
